career-ops.description: Inspect a saved job, assess fit, or prepare an application; use Jobwatch's returned status and reason as the outcome.

assess-fit.description: Assess a saved job against current evidence without writing an application; explain cited requirements, matches, hard gates and uncertainties.

prepare-application.description: Prepare a tailored CV, cover letter and form map for a saved job after human approval. Preparing never submits.

inspect-jobs.description: Find saved jobs and explain current status using the authoritative latest outcome; never infer READY from a chat answer.

company-research.description: Research the employer and the skills the ad asks for; separate ad requirements from public company context; cite sources.

followup-draft.description: Draft a private follow-up for a confirmed application. Nothing is sent.

interview-prep.description: Prepare private, evidence-grounded interview material for a saved job. Never invent experience.

model-insights.description: Explain occupation fits, preference readiness and callback rates from existing calculations; report insufficient data explicitly.
